paragraphs.source_en: As Chief Tachibana asked Kikuno a few more questions of little importance, a group arrived noisily from the police station. Kikuno, therefore, was asked to retire for the time being to the inn where her student was waiting. The group had brought the autopsy report and the results of the comparison of the hand prints.
